page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.7xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 32 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The x86_64 architecture includes 33 MB of L3 cache and supports AVX, AVX512F, AES, and FMA instruction sets. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and offering a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals a clear performance profile characterized by moderate multi-core capabilities contrasted with weaker single-core execution. In single-core tests, such as stress-ng and Geekbench, the instance scores in the bottom 25%, with single-threaded gzip compression falling into the bottom 10%. However, when leveraging all 32 dedicated cores, multi-core performance rises to the middle 50% across stress-ng, Geekbench, and Passmark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth is average, reaching 87.55 GB/sec for large block reads, though the Passmark memory score is relatively weak.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.sn2.7xlarge offers a dense allocation of dedicated physical cores and balanced memory without the added cost of bundled local NVMe storage or GPU accelerators. This makes it a viable option for workloads that scale horizontally across multiple threads rather than relying on high single-core clock speeds. It is well-suited for multi-threaded applications, static web serving, Redis caching layers, and moderate database operations that can utilize the 128 GB memory capacity and 6 Gbps network throughput.
